chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hannan ibn Sadir, from Ma'ruf ibn Kharrabudh, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, we are but like the stars of the sky: whenever one star disappears, another star rises, until when you point with your fingers and crane your necks, Allah will hide your star from you. Then the sons of 'Abd al-Muttalib will become alike, and it will not be known which one is from which. So when your star rises, then praise your Lord.

key_terms.غَابَ: disappeared or became absent from sight
key_terms.نَجْمَكُمْ: your star; referring contextually to the awaited guide
key_terms.نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ: the stars of the sky; a metaphor for successive divine guides

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the ghaybah and the reappearance of the Imam?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام likens the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام to the stars of the sky, indicating their ongoing divine guidance through successive Imams. The report also alludes to a period of concealment in which the divinely appointed guide will be hidden, followed by his reappearance, at which time the believers are instructed to praise Allah.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hanan Bin Sadeyr, from Marouf Bin Mharrabouz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘But rather, we<sup>asws</sup> are like the stars of the sky. Every time one star disappears, one emerges, to the extent when you indicate with your fingers and tilt with your necks. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Hide your star from you all. So the Clan of Abdul Muttalib<sup>as</sup> would be evenly established and it would not be recognised which one is from which. So when your star does emerge, then Praise your Lord<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hannan ibn Sadir from Ma‘ruf ibn Kharrabudh from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following. “

We are only like the stars in the heavens. Whenever one star disappears (from sight) another one comes in view until you will point out with your fingers and make a gesture with your necks. Allah will cause your star to disappear from your sight. The descendants of ‘Abd al-Muttalib will all look similar as such that one would not know which is whiCh When your star will reappear then you must give thanks to Allah.”
